city_status.summary_sr: Vazduh u Beogradu je umerenog kvaliteta; osetljive grupe mogu osetiti blagi uticaj.
city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorov kontrast naslova kao aktuelan trag: Danas sada navodi evakuaciju u Ukrajini, a Beta kancelariju SZO u Luksemburgu; nijedan ne potvrđuje zajednički beogradski događaj. Ne mogu ni prikazani pad sa 387 na 0 na Obilićevom vencu da pretvorim u dokaz dolaska automobila: Parking servis ne daje vreme merenja, pa promena ne utvrđuje ni kada se dogodila ni njen uzrok. [F7][F9][F4][F5]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector's headline contrast as a current lead: Danas now names an evacuation in Ukraine and Beta a WHO office in Luxembourg, neither establishing a shared Belgrade event [F7][F9]. I also cannot turn the displayed fall from 387 to 0 at Obilićev venac into evidence of arriving cars: Parking Servis supplies no measurement time, so the change establishes neither its timing nor its cause [F4][F5].
